contract: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= n <= 100000","description":"The number of towns n must be between 1 and 100,000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"0 <= m <= 100000","description":"The number of roads m must be between 0 and 100,000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"1 <= s <= k <= min(n, 100)","description":"The number of different types of goods s must be between 1 and k, and k must be between 1 and the minimum of n and 100."},{"id":"P4","expression":"all(1 <= a_i <= k for a_i in a)","description":"Each town must produce a type of goods that is between 1 and k."},{"id":"P5","expression":"len(set(a)) == k","description":"All integers between 1 and k must occur at least once among the types of goods produced in the towns."},{"id":"P6","expression":"all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)","description":"Each road must connect two distinct towns within the range of 1 to n."},{"id":"P7","expression":"len(roads) == m","description":"The number of roads must match the specified number m."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"len(stdout.split()) == n","description":"The output must contain exactly n numbers, one for each town."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"all(int(x) >= 0 for x in stdout.split())","description":"Each number in the output must be a non-negative integer representing the minimum travel expenses."
